fields.Name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 (Local)
fields.Description: Quantized MS MARCO MiniLM-L-6-v2 cross-encoder reranker running client-side via Transformers.js ONNX/WASM for Wave 6C edge agent pre-discovery.

Calibrations.Question: matches
Calibrations.FittedOn: MJ Wave 6C Edge AI PoC (N=75 labelled requests): raw cross-encoder logit converted via sigmoid(logit) then Platt-scaled with ApplyPlattCalibration(sigmoid(logit), { A: 1.0, B: 3.8 }) = sigmoid(1.0 * logit + 3.8). At logit >= -2.0 (~0.8581 calibrated confidence), 100.0% precision (20/20) and 0.0% false triggers across 15 none cases.
